List the harmonized offence keys

Source: R/pks_offences.R
pks_offences.Rd

The district tables contain a selected subset of offence keys (Straftatenschluessel). The harmonized keys used by pks_get() are listed here with a short name and a label in German or English, their parent key and the years they cover. Mappings and names marked status = "draft" have not been reviewed yet.

Usage

pks_offences(pattern = NULL, lang = NULL)

Arguments

pattern

Optional text to search for in the keys, short names and labels of both languages. Capitals, spaces and umlauts do not matter, so "Diebstahl", "theft" and "435*00" all work.

lang

Language of the name and label columns: "de" or "en". NULL (default) uses options(pksR.lang), otherwise the language of the R session.

Value

A tibble with offence_key, name (the short name accepted by pks_get(offence = )), label, parent_key, valid_from, valid_to, status and notes.

Details

The table is a snapshot of the offence map of pksR-data that ships with the package, so it works offline. Each data release also contains its own offence_map.csv, which pks_get() uses.

Deutsch

Listet die harmonisierten Straftatenschlüssel mit Kurzname, Bezeichnung auf Deutsch oder Englisch, übergeordnetem Schlüssel und Gültigkeitsjahren. pattern durchsucht Schlüssel, Kurznamen und Bezeichnungen beider Sprachen; lang wählt die Sprache der Spalten name und label. Zuordnungen mit status = "draft" sind noch nicht geprüft.

See also

Other metadata: pks_breaks()

Examples

pks_offences("Diebstahl", lang = "de")

#>    offence_key name            label parent_key valid_from valid_to status notes

#>  2 ***100      kraftwagendieb… Dieb… ****00           2013     2025 draft  NA   
#>  3 ***200      kraftrad_diebs… Dieb… ****00           2014     2025 draft  NA   
#>  4 ***300      fahrraddiebsta… Dieb… ****00           2014     2025 draft  NA   
#>  5 *26*00      ladendiebstahl  Lade… ****00           2023     2025 draft  New …
#>  6 *50*00      diebstahl_an_a… Dieb… ****00           2003     2025 draft  Defi…
#>  7 *90*00      taschendiebsta… Tasc… ****00           2014     2025 draft  NA   
#>  8 3***00      einfacher_dieb… Dieb… ****00           2014     2025 draft  NA   
#>  9 326*00      einfacher_lade… Einf… 3***00           2014     2025 draft  Also…
#> 10 4***00      schwerer_diebs… Dieb… ****00           2014     2025 draft  NA   
#> 11 435*00      wohnungseinbru… Wohn… 4***00           2003     2025 draft  Labe…
